def main():
    num = int(input().strip())
    
    # Extract octal digits from least significant to most significant
    digit1 = num % 8
    num = num // 8
    digit2 = num % 8
    num = num // 8
    digit3 = num % 8
    
    # Print in reverse order (most significant first)
    print(f"{digit3}{digit2}{digit1}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
